protocol: gpt-6-astra, reasoning effort high, $20 model-usage budget per synthesis run, source access, five synthesis runs (seeds 24, 42, 222, 424, 444), 100 held-out instances per run, evaluation seed 792075 as in the main-setting runs, 60-second timeout per instance. All 14,000 episodes completed without crashes.
selection: Every run in the collection, including runs inside multi-run bundles, is checked against the protocol above. For each environment and synthesis seed, the latest complete 100-instance evaluation is selected. Duplicate revisions do not add weight.
precision: Compute each per-run success rate from its 100 per-episode outcomes. Average the five rates, rounded to two decimals (round half up) to match the printed paper precision. Record unrounded means separately.

computationTime.rule: Per run: median over episodes of 1000 × policy_time_s / num_steps from results.json. Per environment: mean over this method’s runs with 100% held-out success. Row: equal-environment mean, with min–max across environment means.
